items.name: moeru-ai/airi
items.one_liner: Self-hosted AI companion with voice chat and game-playing abilities
items.pain_point: Users want private, owned AI companions instead of locked platform experiences; anime/gaming communities and lonely users pay for emotional connection

AI Language Tutor: conversational voice partner with cultural personality (anime character, etc.) for immersive language practice
AI Gaming Coach: overlays on games to give real-time tips, strategy, and companionship while you play

items.why_now: Open-source voice models + cheap inference + massive Character.AI/Replika userbase seeking self-hosted alternatives

items.name: bradautomates/claude-video
items.one_liner: AI-powered video search and summarization for any video content
items.pain_point: Videos are unsearchable black boxes; content creators, researchers, and marketers waste hours manually watching to find insights; they'd pay for instant AI extraction
app_ideas: YouTube Video Intelligence Tool - paste any YouTube URL, instantly ask questions, get timestamps, summaries, and key clips
Meeting Memory - records Zoom/Google Meet calls, transcribes, indexes, lets you ask 'what did client say about pricing last month'
Course Note Taker - students paste lecture videos, get searchable summaries, key concept extraction, and quiz generation
items.monetization: freemium with usage-based API pricing; B2B white-label for enterprise meeting tools
items.why_now: Video content exploded 5x with remote work, but AI vision models just reached quality threshold to make video queryable at scale
